notes: Mirage is quiet again. Nothing on the panel is bold any more: how heavy and how solid a reading is drawn now follows its SIZE — small text is heavier and more present so it survives being rendered, large text is thinner and more…
The power controls are now four thin icons — a padlock, a crescent, a circling arrow and a power ring — instead of four words in capitals.
The media card leads with a play or pause mark rather than the word PLAYING.
Today's date on the calendar is no longer a solid white block. It is simply the only date at full strength, which is the quietest way one day in a grid can be the answer.
Every rune's name is now the same size as every other rune's, so a row of cards reads as one row rather than four different sizes.
